SELECT fdwname,pg_get_userbyid(fdwowner)=current_user AS current_owner,fdwhandler,fdwvalidator::regproc::text AS validator,fdwacl IS NULL AS default_acl,fdwoptions FROM pg_foreign_data_wrapper WHERE fdwname LIKE 'wrapper_%' ORDER BY fdwname

CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER wrapper_bad HANDLER wrong_wrapper_handler

CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER wrapper_bad NO HANDLER NO HANDLER

CREATE SERVER wrapper_server TYPE 'kind' VERSION 'one' FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER wrapper_none OPTIONS (arbitrary 'server')
SELECT s.srvname,w.fdwname,s.srvtype,s.srvversion,s.srvoptions FROM pg_foreign_server s JOIN pg_foreign_data_wrapper w ON w.oid=s.srvfdw WHERE s.srvname='wrapper_server'
CREATE FOREIGN TABLE wrapper_rows(a integer,b text) SERVER wrapper_server OPTIONS (arbitrary 'table')
SELECT * FROM wrapper_rows
SELECT * FROM wrapper_rows LIMIT 0
CREATE VIEW wrapper_view AS SELECT b FROM wrapper_rows
SELECT * FROM wrapper_view
BEGIN; SAVEPOINT before_wrapper
CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER wrapper_rollback; ROLLBACK TO before_wrapper
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_foreign_data_wrapper WHERE fdwname='wrapper_rollback'
COMMIT
CREATE ROLE wrapper_other; SET ROLE wrapper_other
CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER wrapper_denied
CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER wrapper_plain HANDLER missing_handler
RESET ROLE
CREATE TABLE wrapper_validation_calls(options text[], scope oid)
CREATE FUNCTION wrapper_validator(options text[], scope oid) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO wrapper_validation_calls VALUES (options, scope); RETURN 7; END $$
CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER wrapper_valid VALIDATOR wrapper_validator OPTIONS (z 'last',a 'first')
CREATE SERVER wrapper_valid_server FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER wrapper_valid OPTIONS (z 'server-last',a 'server-first')
CREATE FOREIGN TABLE wrapper_valid_rows (a integer) SERVER wrapper_valid_server OPTIONS (z 'table-last',a 'table-first')
SELECT srvoptions FROM pg_foreign_server WHERE srvname='wrapper_valid_server'
SELECT scope::integer, options FROM wrapper_validation_calls ORDER BY scope
CREATE FUNCTION wrapper_coercion_validator(text[],bigint) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE SQL RETURN 1
CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER wrapper_invalid VALIDATOR wrapper_coercion_validator
CREATE FUNCTION wrapper_default_validator(text[],oid,integer DEFAULT 1) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE SQL RETURN 1
CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER wrapper_invalid VALIDATOR wrapper_default_validator
CREATE PROCEDURE wrapper_validator_proc(text[],oid) LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ SELECT 1 $$
CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER wrapper_invalid VALIDATOR wrapper_validator_proc

CREATE FUNCTION wrapper_reject_validator(options text[], scope oid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO wrapper_validation_calls VALUES (options,scope); RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='rejected wrapper options'; END $$
CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER wrapper_rejected VALIDATOR wrapper_reject_validator OPTIONS (a 'rejected')
SELECT scope::integer, options FROM wrapper_validation_calls ORDER BY scope
DROP FUNCTION wrapper_validator(text[],oid)
